About

Hi, I'm Wai Yee

I sit at the intersection of AdTech operations, client success, and creative. Across BBC Studios, SPH Media, and McDonald's Singapore, I've owned everything from campaign trafficking and programmatic delivery to post-sale client relationships and renewal outcomes.

I started out designing campaign creative and premiums for McDonald's Singapore, which is part of why I'm comfortable going deep with agencies and clients on creative optimisation, not just delivery mechanics.

Recent focus: APAC sales planning across North Asia and Southeast Asia, bridging client needs with internal insights teams, and building SOPs that other regions have adopted.
